eva: quick sync 11am PT today to lock press slots + thermal mitigations for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi marketplace previews. need vendor freeze, embargo buffer, and a fallback plan.

sam: invite sent. agenda: freeze tags, lab carve, press embargo cascade, fallback routing.

liam: perf note  H200 sustained runs spike thermals after 30m on eu racks. vendors, can you ship a reduced-power image or firmware tweak?

nora: labs can host a 36h smoke window Fri-Sat if canaries arrive Wed noon and are signed. marketing wants 5 business days between driver freeze and press assets.

vendor-bot: Tentative tags: h100-fw-2025-01-08, h200-canary:v20250109, b200-img:v20250107, mi300-fw-2025-01-05, gaudi-driver:v3.0. Thermal exporter v0.6 available (50ms sampling).

eva: proposed short matrix (draft): H100/B200 -> canary Jan 9-10 -> freeze Jan 12 -> US preview Jan 20 -> EU preview Jan 27 -> public Feb 3; H200 -> canary Jan 11-13 -> extended perf Jan 14-18 -> freeze Jan 19 -> preview Jan 27 -> public Feb 5 (fallback active).

liam: +1 on fallback. propose automatic routing to b200-stable for any customer with >9% long-seq regression during preview. infra will alert_eng and notify partner.

nora: action items: 1) vendors reply "ACK + tag" 2) perf run on canaries (liam) 3) labs carve + require signed images 48h prior (nora) 4) marketing embargo ack (sam) 5) fallback language for marketplace entry (eva).
